evidence_legs.durability: This capture binds the cohort to the catalog source revision/hash and retains the pilot producer and results. The executable ongoing full-cohort watcher is .31.3.2; exhaustive qualification is .31.3.3.
evidence_legs.falsify: Independent authored field/observation names distinguish retained report-only metadata from empty-but-successful normalized lowering. Full pilot equality covers nested payloads; prior T1868/T1871 baseline failures establish routing/diagnostic/version controls.
evidence_legs.rederive: Native RegressionCorpus and capability builders produce the selected cohort and contract census; the tracked pilot compares actual native CLI and newline-stdio MCP results.

limits: This selection is not completed exhaustive qualification; only the named pilot and previously committed VIAL/alias/failure tests have run.
Catalog coverage buckets describe contracts, not independent product-feature counts; the four broad family labels are too coarse for semantic completeness.
Internal compiler/startup qualification, original spent captures and dependency implementation remain outside these source-only queries.
No new concrete coverage defect was established by the selected pilot.

selection.capabilities: Compare native full manifest and both VIAL public capability records with MCP access; runtime/backend availability remains discovery metadata and never grants execution through MCP.
selection.guard: Derive source/query coverage from the native public applicability map and corpus, reject unknown suffixes or unmapped VIAL sources, assert native success and full API/MCP report parity. Explicit source selection supports ordinary focused work; exhaustive execution is reserved for qualification/important gates.
selection.independent_observations: Retain fixture-authored storage field and observation identities on schedule reports; inspect direct/composition roots, aggregate protocol metadata and VIAL lifecycle records through their canonical producers instead of treating success flags as feature evidence.
selection.negative_population: Select representative structured source failures plus version/path/schema controls. Expected-failure catalog entries are a separate negative population, not silently promoted to successful features.
selection.new_feature_rule: A new public source feature needs a support-catalog case and API/MCP evidence on its actual semantic or schedule surface; new VIAL source/version pairs need explicit mapping. A supported feature must not be omitted merely because lowering drops its source-only metadata.
selection.population: Every supported_smoke catalog source, deduplicated by path while retaining every catalog ID and coverage bucket. Hardware uses strict check/semantic and schedule where publicly applicable. VIAL versions are explicitly mapped from the documented sources.
